questions.prompt: Which of these cities have hosted the Summer Olympics?
questions.fact: Triathlon made its Olympic debut at Sydney 2000, starting with a swim beside the Opera House.

questions.prompt: Which of these cities stand on the Danube?
questions.fact: The Danube runs through or along ten countries, more than any other river on Earth.

questions.prompt: How heavy is a newborn baby, on average, in kilograms?
questions.fact: About 3.5 kg. Most babies lose a little weight in their first few days, then gain it back within a fortnight.

questions.prompt: How many characters could a tweet have when Twitter started?
questions.fact: 140, so a tweet would fit in a text message with room for a username.

questions.prompt: Which bird lays the biggest egg?
questions.hint: It is also the biggest bird alive.
questions.fact: One ostrich egg holds as much as about two dozen hen's eggs.

questions.prompt: Which pastry are profiteroles made from?
questions.hint: It is also used for eclairs.
questions.fact: Choux pastry puffs up in the oven because the water in it turns to steam.

questions.prompt: Invasion confirmed. Dock at Wikiplanet Station and pull up its satellite feed.
Second landing site on the feed. Name it and the fleet moves.
